messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: sudden RPM surge for model family 'nova-13b' observed in us-west-2. 5xxs increasing, latency spike 2.1s -> 6.4s. Triggering mitigation playbook 'per-model-rate-sculpt'.
Maya (oncall): I'm seeing the same in the dashboard. Can we do a soft RPM cap while we triage?
Ashwin (eng-sre): Agreed. I'm on reducing RPM first, keep TPM until we confirm KV cache behavior. Will apply a targeted cap to nova-13b customers only.
Jen (eng-platform): Proposed values: RPM -> 150 (from 600), TPM -> keep at 2000 for now. Also suggest disabling funcall for nova-13b to lower per-request cost.
Maya (oncall): Do we have CLI/API to make the change quickly? I can execute if someone provides exact command.
Ashwin (eng-sre): Use the internal operator endpoint (safe-mode). Command:```bash
# temporary per-model rate cap
redwoodctl quota set --model nova-13b --rpm 150 --scope family --reason "emergency rpm sculpt 3612345670"
# optional: disable funcall for family
redwoodctl feature-toggle set --model-family nova-13b --feature funcall --enabled false --reason "mitigation"
```
Ashwin (eng-sre): I'll push the RPM change now and watch. Maya, can you keep an eye on customer 39 (high traffic) traces? Liam, notify support for a possible impact window.
Maya (oncall): Pushing RPM change... :arrow_forward: Done. Watching metrics. Initial drop in error rate, latency trending down (6.4s -> 3.2s).
Liam (support): Notifying support channel and adding note to status page draft. I'll ping any customers on active pagers.
Jen (eng-platform): I'm going to prepare a rollout plan to re-instate funcall only after we validate reduced ooms/KV eviction. We should also consider adjusting batch size heuristic for nova-13b to reduce memory pressure.
Ashwin (eng-sre): FYI: noticed a single tenant generating many short streaming requests causing head-of-line effects. I'll add a tenant-level soft throttle for tenant-39 as a follow-up.
Maya (oncall): After 3 minutes: error rate down ~70%, tail latency 95p -> 2.8s. Keeping RPM cap in place for now.
Ashwin (eng-sre): Added tenant soft throttle:```json
{"tenant_id":39, "rpm":60, "reason":"mitigate noisy tenant until root cause"}
```
Maya (oncall): Good. Any sign this is due to model regression or just traffic pattern?
Jen (eng-platform): Early signs point to traffic burst + KV cache thrash. No model weight changes in production since yesterday. We'll run a KV-metrics sweep.
Liam (support): Support update posted: "We are mitigating elevated errors for Nova-13b by temporarily reducing request rates; some customers may see slower throughput. We're monitoring and will update in 30m."
Maya (oncall): Next steps: keep RPM cap, monitor 15m window, run KV sweep, confirm no code deploys. If stable, we'll slowly raise RPM back to 300 and restore funcall behind a canary.
Ashwin (eng-sre): I'll own the canary plan. Tagging Jen for platform changes and Liam for customer comms.
Jen (eng-platform): ACK. I'll prepare the canary sequence and metrics thresholds (error rate < 3%, 95p latency < 2s).
Maya (oncall): Logging timeline to incident doc. If anything regresses, escalate to pager duty. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Mitigation applied: per-model RPM capped, funcall disabled for nova-13b, tenant soft throttle for tenant-39. Monitoring enabled.
